Inclusion Criteria:
  -  patient with acute respiratory failure, not intubated, [AND]  who require non invasive mechanical ventilation
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  patients in which it is not possible to place the esophageal catheter  [OR] or it is not possible to detect the diaphragm by ultrasound  [OR] or it is not possible to apply the nasal cannula device
